description: A two-room flat with a galley kitchen, a bed and a woodblock floor lifting at the corners. A picture window opens onto a balcony just wide enough for a chair. From here the Basin fills the bottom half of the window. You can hear the stairs through the west wall. The bathroom is through a door at the back.

window.description: A bronze-framed picture window onto the balcony. From up here the Basin is most of the view.
window.name: the balcony window

name: Kestrel Court, Unit 7A
